verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Public APIv2 with an OpenAPI reference, OAuth setup, and an MCP server, but no official client SDK (language library or package) appears anywhere in the pack. A REST API reference is a building block a developer could wrap, not an official SDK. The axis applies to a SaaS compliance platform, so the absence of an SDK is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
